title: FerroCrate Bounded Contexts
description: Domain-Driven Design bounded contexts for the FerroCrate container runtime, mapped to Rust module structure

ContainerRuntime.description: Core container lifecycle management - process isolation, namespaces, cgroups, and container execution
ContainerRuntime.responsibility: Manage container lifecycle: create, start, stop, kill, pause, exec operations

rust_representation.ownership_model: Owns Container processes; borrowing for inspection

invariants: Container state transitions must be atomic
No zombie containers - all processes must be reaped
Resource limits are enforced before process spawn

ImageManagement.description: OCI image handling - pull, push, store, build, and layer management
ImageManagement.responsibility: Manage OCI images: pull from registries, store with deduplication, build from Dockerfile

rust_representation.ownership_model: Owns image layers; Arc for shared manifest references

invariants: Content-addressable storage - Blake3 hash verification on every read
Atomic image operations - no partial pulls visible to consumers
Layer deduplication is transparent to callers

Networking.description: Container networking - bridge, host, overlay networks with eBPF-based packet handling
Networking.responsibility: Manage container networks: create networks, assign IPs, configure port mapping, DNS

rust_representation.ownership_model: Owns network namespaces; borrows container references for attachment

invariants: IP allocation is collision-free within a network
Port mappings are exclusive - no double-binding
Network isolation is enforced at kernel level

BuildSystem.description: Image build system - Dockerfile parsing, multi-stage builds, build cache optimization
BuildSystem.responsibility: Build OCI images from Dockerfiles: parse, execute steps, layer caching, multi-stage builds

rust_representation.ownership_model: Owns build context; borrows from ferro-store for layer persistence

invariants: Build steps are deterministic - same inputs produce same layers
Cache keys incorporate base layer hash
Multi-stage builds only copy required artifacts

ManagementLayer.description: Optional management daemon - Docker API compatibility, long-running container monitoring
ManagementLayer.responsibility: Provide daemon mode: API server, container state tracking, event streaming

rust_representation.ownership_model: Manages state; serves HTTP API via axum

invariants: API is optional - daemonless mode is default
State persistence survives daemon restart
Event streaming is ordered by timestamp

IntelligenceLayer.description: AI-powered container intelligence - resource prediction, anomaly detection, automated remediation
IntelligenceLayer.responsibility: Provide intelligent container management: predict resources, detect anomalies, suggest remediation

rust_representation.ownership_model: Reads metrics via borrowing; owns prediction models

invariants: AI decisions are advisory - never block critical operations
All AI decisions are explainable with logged reasoning
Graceful degradation - system works without AI layer

ComposeOrchestration.description: Multi-container orchestration - docker-compose compatibility, service dependencies, scaling
ComposeOrchestration.responsibility: Orchestrate multi-service applications: parse compose files, manage dependencies, scale services

rust_representation.ownership_model: Owns ComposeProject; borrows container references for coordination

invariants: Dependency order is respected - depends_on with conditions
Service scaling maintains consistent naming
Environment variable substitution is deterministic

ContainerRuntime_ImageManagement.integration: ImageManifest passed by value, Layers borrowed for mount

ContainerRuntime_Security.description: Runtime and Security collaborate on container creation
ContainerRuntime_Security.integration: SecurityContext built by Security, consumed by Runtime

ContainerRuntime_Networking.description: Runtime requests network endpoints from Networking

IntelligenceLayer_All.description: Intelligence observes all contexts but doesn't control them

ComposeOrchestration_All.integration: High-level commands translated to context operations

trait_based_abstraction.description: DDD interfaces map to Rust traits for polymorphism
trait_based_abstraction.example: ContainerRepository trait implemented by InMemoryContainerRepo, PersistentContainerRepo

rules: Aggregates own their entities (Container owns Process)
Value objects are Copy or Clone (ContainerId, ImageDigest)
References between aggregates use IDs, not direct references

error_handling.description: Domain errors as enums with thiserror
